title: ChIPmentation: fast, robust, low-input ChIP-seq for histones and transcription factors.
scope: Cells/chromatin through antibody-directed enrichment, tagmentation, library preparation, sequencing and enrichment interpretation; keep histone/transcription-factor alternatives explicit.

states.description: Cells entering one selected target-specific ChIP recipe. Cultured K562 cells and isolated PBMCs are reported study contexts, not universal input requirements. Demonstrated low-input profiles used 10,000 cells for H3K4me3/H3K27me3 and 100,000 for GATA1/CTCF; these are examples rather than universal minimums. Antibody quality limits feasibility and new antibodies/cell types may require ChIP optimization.

evidence.quote: 20 μl of Protein A (or Protein G, dependent on the antibody used) magnetic beads were blocked overnight with 0.1% BSA in PBS and added to the IP the next day for 2 hours on a rotator at 4°C to capture the immunoprecipitated fragments.

states.description: Alternative version 2 target-associated crosslinked chromatin captured on magnetic beads using one selected antibody (H3K4me1, H3K36me3 or REST); target choices are not mixed.

evidence.quote: In parallel, 50 µl (10 µl for low-input ChIPmentation) magnetic Protein A or Protein G beads (dependent on the antibody used) were blocked and conjugated to an antibody by washing and resuspending twice in PBS, 0.5% BSA, 0.5% Tween- 20. The antibody was added and bound to the beads by rotating >1 hour at room temperature.

operations.name: Perform analytical nick translation and qPCR
operations.action: Before preparing PCR, incubate KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix at 98°C for 45 s to activate the enzyme for successful nick translation in the first PCR step. Amplify the 1 μl library aliquot in a 10 μl qPCR with 0.15 μM primers, 1× SYBR Green and 5 μl 2× KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix. Program: 72°C 5 min, 98°C 30 s; 24 cycles of 98°C 10 s / 63°C 30 s / 72°C 30 s; final 72°C 1 min. Measure Cq to estimate enrichment cycles. operations.information_effect: Initial nick translation supports library amplification; SYBR fluorescence yields Cq. This analytical measurement governs production cycle count; analytical product does not establish a material input to sequencing.

evidence.quote: 1 μl of each library was amplified in a 10-μl qPCR reaction containing 0.15 μM primers, 1x SYBR green and 5 μl 2x KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (Kapa Biosystems) to estimate the optimum number of enrichment cycles with the following program: 72°C 5 min, 98°C 30 s, 24 cycles of 98°C 10 s 63°C 30 s 72°C 30 s, and a final elongation at 72°C for 1 min.
evidence.rationale: Supports o_qpcr as a source-described procedure: Before preparing PCR, incubate KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix at 98°C for 45 s to activate the enzyme for successful nick translation in the first PCR step. Amplify the 1 μl library aliquot in a 10 μl qPCR with 0.15 μM primers, 1× SYBR Green and 5 μl 2× KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix. Program: 72°C 5 min, 98°C 30 s; 24 cycles of 98°C 10 s / 63°C 30 s / 72°C 30 s; final 72°C 1 min. Measure Cq to estimate enrichment cycles. Custom Nextera PCR primers as explicitly delegated to the ATAC-seq design inventory: common Ad1_noMX plus a selectable Ad2 design. All 24 Ad2 designs are available choices, not a combined reaction, a ChIPmentation sample-to-index map, loaded transposase strands, cell barcodes or UMIs. Inventory labels and literal sequences are retained separately in resources.

modules.name: Specimen quantity and selection of a ChIP alternative
modules.boundary_rationale: Starts at cellular specimens; one target/recipe is selected for a given library. Target-specific low-input demonstrations limit applicability, not universal cell minimums.

modules.name: Prepare and enrich target-associated chromatin
modules.boundary_rationale: Ends at LiCl-washed enriched chromatin on beads. Distinct lysis, sonication, antibody and wash recipes remain alternatives; no hybrid histone/TF recipe is formed.

modules.name: Introduce sequencing-adapter tags before DNA release
modules.boundary_rationale: Begins at enriched bead-bound chromatin and ends at washed tagmented chromatin, preserving branch-specific wash identities around the common tagmentation chemistry.

modules.name: Release and purify target-attributed tagged DNA
modules.boundary_rationale: Deproteinization/crosslink reversal changes the material from chromatin on beads to purified tagged DNA. Versions 1/3 re-extract; version 2 does not inherit that step. Alternative outputs converge without physical pooling.

modules.name: Analytical aliquot and controlled production enrichment
modules.boundary_rationale: Separates measurement material from production material; measured Cq controls production cycle count. Final size-selected library and incompletely specified QC bound sequencing entry.

modules.name: Sequence target and independent IgG libraries
modules.boundary_rationale: Turns attributed physical libraries into processed target and background data. IgG preparation is a reported boundary with unknown internals, not an invented target-recipe assignment.

modules.name: Interpret relative genomic enrichment
modules.boundary_rationale: Produces normalized genomic tracks, independently/background-called peaks, consistency-gated merged peaks and FRiP. Exploratory structural applications do not become required enrichment protocol steps.

unresolved.description: The draft CHEM-G01 pending-inspection blocker is resolved at the material-route level by Supplementary Note p00039/p00040/p00043/p00044 (CHEM-F03–F15) and at the primer-inventory level by cited ATAC-seq supplement p00001/p00002 (CHEM-F16–F17); it is not evidence that these operations are unavailable. Residual noncritical preparation-recipe limits in the inspected Supplementary Note: glycine concentration/amount and quench time, several lysis/resuspension volumes, numerical full-speed centrifugation settings, version 2 TE composition, Proteinase K stock activity/concentration, and antibody-specific Protein A/G choice are not given there. These restrict reproduction as a complete SOP, not the supported cells→fixed chromatin→enriched beads→purified tagged DNA route. CTCF is stated as 10 μl/IP, so its mass remains unknown. No contradictory execution is asserted.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original version-specific preparation SOP/reagent sheets supplying these missing quantities and antibody-resin assignments; for a chosen new specimen/target, validated ChIP optimization conditions. Preserve the source-supported boundaries meanwhile.

unresolved.description: Exact molecular-end detail remains limited: main p00004/p00016/p00018 and supplement p00005 establish Tn5 fragmentation/adapter tagging and initial nick translation; the inspected ATAC-seq dependency and PCR oligo inventory do not specify the original kit’s enzyme activity/concentration, loaded transposon strand sequences, transferred strand ends or full covalent intermediate. PCR-primer sequences must not be relabelled as loaded Tn5 adapters. The named-kit tagmentation and amplification boundary is supported for frozen scope; a claim about exact end chemistry or a custom transposase substitution is not established.
unresolved.next_evidence: Contemporaneous Illumina Nextera DNA Sample Prep Kit loaded-adapter/enzyme technical documentation and a source linking its exact strand architecture to this original ChIPmentation variant; do not replace with later kit or remembered defaults.

unresolved.description: Library-primer and amplification assignment limit: main p00018 links custom Nextera primers to the cited ATAC-seq source, whose table provides 25 oligo designs, but no general ChIPmentation sample-to-Ad2 map or index-read orientation is specified. Main p00018 explicitly gives the analytical qPCR thermal program and a separate production composition/Cq cycle rule; it does not independently state a complete final-PCR thermal program or volume of purified DNA transferred into that reaction. The ATAC dependency p00017 has a different preamplification/qPCR architecture and cannot silently fill these details. This does not block the general indexed-library amplification route or require historical sample reconstruction.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original ChIPmentation amplification/indexing SOP clarifying the production program, DNA input volume and primer-pair/index-read convention for a selected library design. Historical sample maps are needed only for claims about a particular executed sample.

unresolved.description: SPRI internal detail limit: main p00018 reports 0.7:1 removal of >600 bp DNA followed by 2:1 recovery of remaining DNA, supporting first-supernatant/second-bead retention. It does not clarify whether the second ratio is an incremental addition or final total in the continued reaction, nor provide final bead washes/elution volume or a lower size bound. Supplementary Note purification alternatives likewise name AMPure/MinElute without full manufacturer internals. These are noncritical detail limits for the published separation boundary; no invented bead-volume arithmetic is claimed.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original two-step SPRI size-selection SOP defining the second ratio’s volume reference and final recovery, plus contemporaneous AMPure XP/MinElute instructions for explicitly delegated internal cleanup details.

unresolved.description: Matched-control preparation boundary: main p00020 requires matched IgG background and Table 2 p00004 shows independent ChIPmentation IgG libraries, but the inspected target-antibody recipes do not specify IgG identity/mass or which of versions 1–3 generated each matched control. A separate sequenced control boundary and its data role are established; an exact control reaction or universal matching rule is not. This is nonblocking for the declared general protocol architecture but limits any claim about fully specified or historically executed control preparation.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original IgG-control SOP stating antibody species/isotype/catalogue/amount, ChIP preparation branch, specimen/input matching and control-library processing; exact pairing is required only if claiming a specific executed comparison.

unresolved.description: Sequencing/interpretation internal settings: inspected main p00018/p00020/p00021 and Table 2 identify platform, read-format examples, alignment/peak-calling rules and enrichment readouts, but do not supply a general pooling/loading recipe, demultiplexing/index-mismatch settings, all software versions/default realizations, a numerical replicate-consistency decision threshold, or QC-triggered rerun rule. Qubit measurements in main p00017/p00019 concern other protocols; they cannot support a ChIPmentation loading controller. These details do not block the source-described sequencing→target-enrichment boundary; no exact numerical reproduction or adaptive loading behavior is claimed.
unresolved.next_evidence: Original facility library submission/loading and demultiplexing SOP, applicable software versions/commands and stated replicate/QC decision criteria if a reproducible numerical analysis or adaptive control claim is required. For general architecture, retain the reported boundaries and qualified rules.
